name: Hardened Ward
description: Pack the ward tight at the point of impact so it turns from a film into a plate against one blow.

name: Stiff Cover
description: Lock the ward rigid and tilt it so a heavy strike skids across it instead of biting.

name: Hammered Plate
description: Beat the ward flat and dense under the lead arm to soak a hard blow into the user's stance.

name: Ward Lunge
description: Lunge forward behind the hardened plate and drive its flat into the opponent's chest.

name: Pace Cover
description: Take a pace forward with the plate raised so the ward never leaves the line between user and opponent.

name: Plate Heft
description: Read the weight of the opponent's blow from the shudder of the plate and tell the user how hard it will fall.

name: Compressed Shell
description: Squeeze the ward to half its width so that it is doubly hard against one heavy blow.

name: Purging Touch
description: Draw a mild poison or taint out of an ally's blood through the ward and let it drain away from the body.

name: Turning Disc
description: Spin a flat disc of qi on the forearm to throw off a strike at the moment of touch.

name: Spun Rim
description: Whirl the rim of the ward outward to catch a cut and fling it wide of the user.

name: Skimming Ward
description: Lay a smooth ward at a shallow angle so that a thrust skims across it and out past the hip.

name: Offset Guard
description: Shift a hand's breadth off the line of a blow while the ward takes up the new angle.

name: Returning Shove
description: Follow a deflected strike with a push of the ward into the striker's open side.

name: Angle Calling
description: Read the angle of a strike from how it meets the ward and call the angle aloud to the nearest ally.

name: Slipped Cover
description: Let a blow slide under the raised ward and shift the cover down to meet it at the hip.

name: Glass Turn
description: Turn a strike with a hard brittle ward so the striker's arm swings wide and leaves the striker open.

name: Rebound Plate
description: Hold a dense plate square to a thrown weapon or loosed force and snap it back toward its sender.

name: Steering Palm
description: Guide a stream of blows past the user with the palm and a sliding ward without once giving ground.

name: Tending Warmth
description: Hold warm qi over an ally's wound until the bleeding slows and the edges lie together.

name: Stanch Hold
description: Press a ward over a deep cut to clamp it shut and keep an ally from bleeding out.

name: Guard Over
description: Kneel over a fallen ally and hold a broad ward across both of them until help comes.

name: Hurt Reading
description: Feel through the palm where an ally is hurt worst so the ward and the mending go there first.

name: Washing Qi
description: Wash a stinging taint from an ally's wound with a slow stream of clean qi drawn through the ward.

name: Closing Mend
description: Knit a deep cut shut from the inside with threads of qi while the ward holds the wound still.

name: Joined Wardlink
description: Join the user's ward to the ward of the ally at the side so the two hold as a single plate.

name: Chain Cover
description: Pass a strand of qi from ward to ward along a line of allies so each guards the next.

name: Palm Joining
description: Set the palm to an ally's back and share the shock of a heavy blow between the two bodies.

name: Twinned Brace
description: Lock shoulders with an ally and brace both wards against the same blow at the same instant.

name: Passing Edge
description: Pass a keen edge of the user's ward along the link to an ally's guard to firm it for a blow.

name: Shared Sense
description: Feel along the link for any ally whose ward is thinning and send the user's qi there.

name: Linked Barrier
description: Hold a ward across a whole file of allies by sharing its weight along the join through a long exchange.

name: Lending Aegis
description: Pour a steady share of the user's ward into an ally whose own is failing and keep it flowing.

name: Tethered Screen
description: Tie a screen of qi to each ally in reach so that a blow on one is spread among all.

name: Back Ward
description: Close the ward over the user's back where the partner's guard begins so no seam is left.

name: Shoulder Cover
description: Drop a ward over the partner's turning shoulder just as the partner twists to strike.

name: Mirrored Pace
description: Step in the opposite direction to the partner and keep the shared ward closed between the two backs.

name: Pair Holding
description: Stand back to back and hold one ward round both bodies through a long surrounding exchange.

name: Echo Feeling
description: Feel a strike land on the partner's ward as an echo in the user's own and turn to meet it.

name: Rear Shell
description: Throw a hard shell over the unguarded rear of the pair when the partner is struck and staggers.

name: Paired Mantle
description: Draw a single mantle of qi round both partners and feed whichever of them is under the heavier press.

name: Borne Weight
description: Take the full weight of a blow on a packed ward and carry it down through the legs.

name: Sinking Hold
description: Sink the whole body half a step lower as the ward soaks a descending cut.

name: Packed Shell
description: Pack qi so densely into the shell that a blow spreads across it before it can pierce.

name: Densened Skin
description: Keep the skin ward dense through a hard exchange and feed it from the stance as it wears.

name: Press Gauge
description: Feel how much more pressure the ward can bear before it cracks and tell the user when to give ground.

name: Braced Pace
description: Take one braced pace under load and keep the ward closed while the stance moves.

name: Backing Push
description: Throw the borne weight back through the ward in a short push that shoves the striker away.

name: Sunk Impact
description: Swallow a heavy impact whole into a deep ward and pass it to the ground without a tremor in the arms.

name: Settling Mend
description: Ease the bruised ribs and strained joints of an ally after a hard blow with warm slow qi.

name: Enduring Bearing
description: Bear a continuous press on the ward for as long as the opponent can lean on it without cracking.

name: Shared Ward
description: Cast the user's ward wide enough to stand over an ally at arm's length.

name: Lent Plate
description: Lend a hard plate of qi to an ally's forearm for the length of one blow.

name: Spread Mantle
description: Spread a light mantle from the user's shoulders so it settles over the nearest two allies.

name: Side Cover
description: Close the ward to the open side of an ally who has turned to strike.

name: Hand Over
description: Clasp an ally's wrist and hand over a measure of ward qi for the next exchange.

name: Count Sense
description: Count by feel how many allies stand within the reach of the user's ward and who is hurt.

name: Common Aegis
description: Hold one broad ward over a small company and shift its thick part toward whichever of them is pressed.

name: Joined Veil
description: Draw a veil from the user's ward over every ally touching the user and firm their guards at once.

name: Under Layer
description: Lay the first layer of the ward close against the skin where it will be needed last.

name: Top Layer
description: Lay a bright outer layer over the first to take the first shock and warn the user of the next.

name: Rim Layer
description: Thicken only the rim of the ward so a cutting edge catches there and slides away.

name: Layer Test
description: Tap the ward with a thread of qi to learn which of its layers is thinnest.

name: Whole Layer
description: Hold every layer of the ward together as one body through the full length of a hard exchange.

name: Shed Husk
description: Throw off the outermost layer with the force of a blow on it and leave the inner layers whole.
